figure_description: A quadrilateral kite shape oriented diagonally on a blank background. It has a sharp, acute vertex pointing toward the bottom left. From this vertex, two long straight sides of equal length extend upward and to the right: one side goes steeply up and right to an upper vertex, and the other side goes gently up and right to a lower-right vertex. The top side is a short horizontal segment extending rightward from the upper vertex, and the right side is a short vertical segment extending upward from the lower-right vertex, meeting at a top-right corner.
